text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis and reasons in opening paragraph","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents a focused position and previews its main reasons in a way that guides the reader."},{"evidence":"first off, secondly, lastly, in closing","quality":"cohesive structure","description":"The essay uses explicit transition signals to sequence ideas and build a recognizable argument structure."},{"evidence":"students won't have time... classes would take longer... school will end at evening time","quality":"development of ideas","description":"The essay elaborates each point with supporting explanation rather than relying on brief assertions."},{"evidence":"for instance, if one student comes home at 4:50 pm...","quality":"specific support","description":"The essay includes concrete examples that make its claims more vivid and persuasive."},{"evidence":"would be feeling less energetic... half asleep... groggily enter the house","quality":"precise word choice","description":"The essay uses more exact descriptive language to convey effects and consequences clearly."},{"evidence":"students won't have time for themselves at home","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay generally forms more controlled sentences with fewer run-on problems and clearer grammatical relationships."},{"evidence":"The school board shouldn't extend the school day","quality":"formal academic style","description":"The essay maintains a more essay-like, school-appropriate tone throughout its argument."}]}
